_note: Regression baselines, not acceptance ceilings: per-path p95 guards derived from recorded runs (the worst p95 over the baseline runs of this platform plus 25 percent, rounded up to a whole millisecond, never below 5 ms). They catch a slowdown of a path against its own recorded past. They do not say the cache meets its ticket: the acceptance ceilings (restore_ms 250, save_ms 220) are in the perf-budget file and the cold-save ceiling miss is tracked as D-1515. Never read a value here as a target and never raise one to hide a regression. The integrity_ms rows are informational and carry no guard. Baselines: hq plan/p7/evidence/CACHE-12-perf.md. Checked by cli tools/perfbench check under the name regression guards.
